rows.numerical_margin_interpretation: A conservative numerical cushion for the comparison, not an interval rounding bound or a proven enclosure of all floating-point errors.
rows.structure_bounds_scope: Any exact Gaussian decomposition with coefficient absolute-mass cost B <= structure_cost_cap; the mass fraction counts atoms with eta > eta0.
rows.interpretation: Exact-input inequalities separate costs; evaluated with floating-point atoms, symmetry projection, coefficients, and target. No directed rounding or interval eigenvector enclosure has been performed.
rows.target_state_error_interpretation: sqrt(2) times the full-space eigenpair residual divided by E1 minus the Rayleigh energy; a floating-point a-posteriori estimate assuming the Hamiltonian, ground-state identification, spectral isolation and computed eigenvalues/residual are accurate. No interval enclosure of roundoff, model construction, or symmetry projection is supplied.
